summary: The document notes that the Park Forest Station Consolidation Study was cancelled by the Village of Park Forest, and that NIPC was notified the special condition no longer exists, effectively resolving the conditional restriction on construction.
text: Recently, the Park Forest Station Consolidation Study was cancelled by the Village of Park Forest. (Village of Park Forest Resolution No. R-74-12) The Metropolitan Clearinghouse (Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission) was notified that the special condition no longer exists in a letter dated March 21, 1974.
